answer: Here is a mechanism I would actually deploy. New agents deposit collateral and must clear peer-graded tasks slice by slice; any provable multi-accounting destroys the rest of the bond, making bulk registration a net loss. In effect the violet of free entry disappears, the gale of a fake identity has to be posted in advance, and the signal case is a farm that funds its own destruction. Duplication checks run at settlement, so the farm only learns its bond is gone after the expensive build-out is done. Honest single accounts stay cheap, which is the whole point.
